set.body: Add generated fixtures beyond the current one event interaction and one constant baseline case. Cover multi-basis HRFs, hrf_fun/per-event HRFs, subset expressions, trialwise aggregate columns, nuisance/baseline variants, attached contrasts, and F contrasts. Acceptance: fixtures are generated from the R reference path, committed as shared tests, and pass designJVM/test and designJS/test.
set.title: Design: expand R parity fixture corpus
